sentences.text: 1.  The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR bearing no. 0139/2021 registered at P.S. Rajouri Garden, under section 498A/406/34 IPC along with consequential judicial proceedings.

2. The counsel for the petitioner stated that the respondent no. 2 who is the wife of petitioner is now living happily with the petitioner and it is reflected from the statement made before the Trial Court.
4. Mr. Utkarsh, APP assisted by IO accepts notice on behalf of respondent no. 1.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/11/2023 at 21:44:18 5.
Let notice be also issued to respondent no. 2 on taking steps by the petitioner within four weeks through all permissible modes returnable on 11.01.2024.
